attenuation.reference: train-only per-dimension means from previous verified statistics

random_masking.rng: numpy PCG64(first128bitsBigEndian(SHA256(canonicalJSON[dataset,seed,dialogue_id,utterance_index,target,ratio,repeat]))); text-all layers consume independent sequential draws

text_layers.meaning: four stored RoBERTa arrays, not established encoder layer indices

visual_missingness.definition: all raw visual dimensions exactly zero
visual_missingness.handling: retain original input and original saved prediction; exclude from active visual intervention; retain in all-sample summary and report present/missing strata separately

inference.optional_equivalent_execution_accelerati: may use tracing/CUDA graph only after full-output parity checks on original and representative strongest modifications; no protocol/parameter changes

analysis.ci: paired percentile 95%; same dialogue draws shared by all conditions of a dataset
analysis.random_mask_aggregation: per-repeat classification metric then mean; per-utterance behavior averaged across repeats, no probability ensemble
analysis.high_sensitivity_case_definition: original confidence>=0.9 and wrong, with flip or true-class probability drop>=0.1 at rho=1
analysis.monotonicity: report adjacent changes across rho0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1 without assuming monotonicity
analysis.interpretation: dependence on feature representations, not reliability, causal emotion evidence, or physical changes
